cases: vista-reliability-v1 cases.json (14 NLST hero scans, 22 LIDC >=2-reader groups)
roi: 96.0 mm cube on unshifted box centre, original grid, int16 HU
diameter: Lung-RADS mean diameter: axial slice with the longest in-plane diameter; long = max Feret over pixel-corner hull, short = extent perpendicular to long; mean=(L+S)/2. Same function for every method and every reader mask.

arm_A.seed: max of Gaussian(1 mm)-smoothed HU within box centre +- max(size/4, 2 mm); fail if < -600
arm_A.background: median HU of cap-sphere voxels < -500 (default -850 if <100 voxels)
arm_A.threshold: T = bg + f*(core - bg), core = smoothed HU at seed
arm_A.mask: HU >= T inside sphere radius max(k*max(size)/2, 5 mm); opening with physical ball radius r; component containing seed, else nearest within 3 mm, else fail

arm_B: VISTA crop64 (hero-crop64-v1 geometry), positive = detector_seed EDT point, 10 negatives: 8 in-plane at 45 deg + 2 along z, radius max(1.5*max(size)/2, 6 mm), clipped to crop; decode ==1
arm_C: box mean diameter (w + h)/2 from detector box x/y sizes
arm_D: detector_seed mask (HU >= -400 component nearest centre, inside box)
selection: arm A params = lowest tune median |diameter error|; tie -> higher tune bin agreement
reference: median reader mean diameter per group; reader ceiling = each reader vs median of the others
caveat: LUNA16 (detector training) is an LIDC subset; arm C on LIDC is likely optimistic
